people.name: Mr. Noel N. Tata
people.evidence_quote: Mr. Noel N. Tata (DIN: 00024713) will retire from the office of Chairman and Director of the Company with effect from the close of business hours on 11th November 2026.
people.tenure_quote: Mr. Tata has been associated with the Company since 1997 and has provided exemplary leadership and strategic direction throughout his tenure.

people.name: Mr. Noel N. Tata
people.evidence_quote: In recognition of his substantial and valuable contribution to the Company , the Board has appointed Mr. Noel N. Tata as Chairman Emeritus with effect from 12th November 2026.

people.name: Mr. Bahram Vakil
people.evidence_quote: Consequent to the above, the Board has  appointed Mr. Bahram Vakil (DIN: 00283980) as  Chairman of the Company with effect from 12th November 2026.

people.name: Mr . Rajiv Dube
people.evidence_quote: Based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, the Board  has approved the appointment of Mr . Rajiv Dube (DIN: 00021796) as an Additional Director  (Non-Executive, Non-Independent) of the Company with effect from 30th October 2026, subject  to the approval of the shareholders.
people.bio_quote: Mr. Rajiv Dube is an Indian industry veteran with over 40 years of multi -sector experience, having  served at the highest echelons of two Indian conglomerates - Tata and Aditya Birla.

people.name: Ms. Kalpana Merchant
people.evidence_quote: Further, the Board has also  approved her appointment as an Independent Director of the Company for a term of three  years commencing from 30th October 2026  up to 2 9th October 20 29 (both days inclusive) ,  subject to the approval of the shareholders.
people.tenure_quote: for a term of three  years commencing from 30th October 2026  up to 2 9th October 20 29 (both days inclusive)
people.bio_quote: Ms. Kalpana Merchant has over 45 years of experience in the legal profession.  She has significant  experience in dealing with the commercial property matters.
